name: UGC 4115 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 4115, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc4115-hubble
story: UGC 4115 belongs to a loose association of dwarf galaxies led by UGC 3974, strung along a filament of nearby galaxies. Hubble measured its distance to weigh how much unseen dark matter such faint groups might hold.

claims.text: UGC 4115 is a Magellanic irregular galaxy
UGC 4115 is a member of the 14+19 association of dwarf galaxies, whose brightest galaxy is UGC 3974
UGC 4115 lies in a filament of galaxies
Hubble program 10210 'Groups of Dwarf Galaxies: Pools of Mostly Dark Matter?' measured distances to dwarf galaxies in dwarf groups
